title: FPS The Easy Way
description: A performance pack made for low end systems so everyone can play modern Minecraft
body:
*for bug reports, requests, and questions contact me at fluffandstuffanim@gmail.com or in the _Curseforge_ comment section - https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/fps-the-easy-way/*

## What is it?
_FPS - The Easy Way_ is a simple pack aiming to allow older systems to run the newest version of minecraft including pre tweaked settings for the best performance.

## Why Choose This Over Others?
In most other optimization packs, they are designed for newer hardware, including fewer optimization packs, expecting that most people are running the latest and greatest. But  _FPS - The Easy Way_ bridges that gap between the newest minecraft versions and slower more outdated hardware, giving peak performance for anyone who might need it.

## Key Features
- This pack includes optimization for all instances like _Fast Noise_ & _Noisium_ for optimized noise generation, _Very Many Players_ for optimization on servers, _Sodium_ for optimized rendering everywhere, and includes other amazing mods such as _Entity Culling_, _Ferrite Core_, _Better Block Entities_ and more!

- This pack includes no extra packs (otherwise known as bloat) for changing the vannila experience, just the basics to make modern Minecraft run amazing on old hardware.

## Things to Note
- Vsync is recomended to avoid stuttering with low memory allocation.
- This pack can also help things run smoothly on modern hardware and for more optimzation, consider pairing this pack with other performance mods such as _Voxy, Distant Horizons,_ or _Nvidium_.
- Updating the mods in the pack works completely fine, just make sure that you also update your _Fabric_ version as well if it has any.

### Specs for Testing
- Proccessor: 4 × Intel® Core™ i5-4310U CPU @ 2.00GHz (Integrated Graphics)
- Memory: 8 GiB of RAM
- Allocation: 2 GB for Minecraft
